Package neqsim.process.dynamics

Class TransientErrorStateVariable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.dynamics.TransientErrorStateVariable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class TransientErrorStateVariable extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable scalar used to compare numerical transient trials in an explicit physical unit.

The absolute tolerance has the same unit as the value; the relative tolerance is dimensionless. Owner and variable identities describe numerical state and must remain stable between trials.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Constructor Details

    • TransientErrorStateVariable

      public TransientErrorStateVariable(String ownerIdentity, String variableIdentity, String unit, double value, double absoluteTolerance, double relativeTolerance)
      Creates one explicitly scaled state value.
      Parameters:
      ownerIdentity - stable identity of the state owner
      variableIdentity - stable variable identity within that owner
      unit - physical unit of the value and absolute tolerance
      value - finite state value
      absoluteTolerance - finite, strictly positive absolute tolerance
      relativeTolerance - finite, nonnegative dimensionless relative tolerance
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identity, value or tolerance is invalid
